invariants.rationale: AssetManager is used to construct AssetManagerAtlasResolver; must not be null.
tmxFile is used in getAtlasFileHandle and loadTiledMap and so must not be null.
Atlas file handle is required for resolver construction.
fileName is typically required for identifying the map file and is likely non-empty.
Both atlasResolver and map fields are assigned in this method and should be non-null by exit.
